# Voicenote AI integration

> Read your own voice notes from an AI assistant using the read-only Voicenote MCP server.

Voicenote supports long recordings, timestamped memos and bookmarks, on-device Whisper transcription, AI summaries with keywords and todos, Supabase account sync, M4A export, and uploaded-file transcription.

## Connection

Endpoint: https://voicenote-ten-alpha.vercel.app/api/mcp
Transport: MCP Streamable HTTP, stateless JSON.
Protocol version: 2025-06-18.
Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer vn_...` on every request.
The documentation is public and requires no authentication; MCP note access requires a personal access token.

## Create a personal access token

Open the app and go to Settings → AI integration → Create token.
Korean: 설정 → AI 연동. Chinese: 设置 → AI 集成.
Copy the token when it is displayed: it is shown only once. Store it securely and use it in your MCP client. Tokens can be revoked at any time in the app. Replace every `vn_...` placeholder below with your own token; never publish it.

## Read-only tools

### list_notes

Arguments: `{query?: string, limit?: number}`

List notes, optionally filtered by query. Limit defaults to 20; maximum 100.

### get_note

Arguments: `{id: string, include_transcript?: boolean}`

Get title, date, duration, summary with timestamps, keywords, todos, memos, and transcript lines formatted as [mm:ss] text. include_transcript defaults to true.

### search_transcripts

Arguments: `{query: string, limit?: number}`

Search transcript text. Results contain noteId, noteTitle, startMs, text. Limit defaults to 20; maximum 100.

### get_summary

Arguments: `{id: string}`

Get a note’s summary.

Use `list_notes` to obtain an actual note ID before calling `get_note` or `get_summary`. Optional parameters may be omitted. For `search_transcripts`, query is required. These tools do not edit or delete notes or create summaries.

## Claude Desktop / Claude Code

In Claude Desktop, use a client configuration that supports a remote Streamable HTTP server with the endpoint and Authorization header above. Availability of custom bearer headers depends on the Desktop version; if unavailable, use Claude Code. The command below registers the server in Claude Code, not in Claude Desktop:

```sh
claude mcp add --transport http voicenote https://voicenote-ten-alpha.vercel.app/api/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer vn_..."
```

## Cursor

Add this entry to your Cursor `mcp.json` (merge it with existing servers):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "voicenote": {
      "url": "https://voicenote-ten-alpha.vercel.app/api/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer vn_..."
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Generic HTTP client / curl

Set `VOICENOTE_TOKEN` in your local shell to your personal token without sharing it. Initialize the client:

```sh
curl https://voicenote-ten-alpha.vercel.app/api/mcp \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VOICENOTE_TOKEN" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' \
  --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"voicenote-example","version":"1.0.0"}}}'
```

Send the initialized notification:

```sh
curl https://voicenote-ten-alpha.vercel.app/api/mcp \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VOICENOTE_TOKEN" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' \
  -H 'MCP-Protocol-Version: 2025-06-18' \
  --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"notifications/initialized"}'
```

Call a tool:

```sh
curl https://voicenote-ten-alpha.vercel.app/api/mcp \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VOICENOTE_TOKEN" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' \
  -H 'MCP-Protocol-Version: 2025-06-18' \
  --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"list_notes","arguments":{"limit":20}}}'
```

The server uses stateless JSON responses: no session ID is needed. Subsequent requests include `MCP-Protocol-Version: 2025-06-18`. MCP messages use JSON-RPC 2.0; inspect responses for JSON-RPC errors and tool errors before using results. `tools/list` discovers the available tools. To retrieve a transcript, call `tools/call` with `{"name":"get_note","arguments":{"id":"YOUR_NOTE_ID","include_transcript":true}}` as params.

## Privacy and access

The data belongs to the token owner. A personal token grants read access to all of that user's notes, not just a selected note. Only connect clients you trust. Revoke the token at any time to stop future access; revocation does not erase data already copied to a client. Recording audio is not exposed via MCP. Notes, transcripts, summaries, keywords, todos, and memos can contain private information; avoid placing tokens or note content in public logs.
